description:
Quality audit 2026-05-17 using boundary-of-responsibility-enforcement found Web Console has useful boundary code and tests, but the durable boundary docs no longer match the current package layout. Evidence: docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md has no Zone Map or Boundary Maturity table; it still describes package-main/session files such as api/session.go and api/session_handlers.go even though current code uses api/session/* plus Connect handlers under api/handlers/*; its Audio Ownership Map still names deleted paths api/internal/voice, api/internal/tts, api/handlers/{voice,tts}, and api/voice_transcribe.go. docs/internal/SEAMS.md opens with a note that those audio paths are deleted, but later still contains detailed seam entries for api/internal/voice, api/internal/tts, and handlers/voice/tts. docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md section 10 contains a large completed/deferred audio extraction dossier whose action items conflict with current enforcement: api/greenfield_assertions_test.go now asserts internal/voice, internal/tts, handlers/voice, and handlers/tts must not reappear, and focused go test for the audio boundary assertions passes. Directory inventory also shows current API zones: handlers/{ai,capabilities,conversation,discovery,events,health,hooks,metrics,sessions,settings,shortcuts,terminal,workspace}; internal/{ai,audio,audioports,backend,capabilities,config,events,metrics,module,modules,policy,pty,ptyfake,sessions,sessionstore,workspace}; plus top-level api/session and api/terminal packages. The docs do not give future agents a one-to-one zone assignment for these directories.

Draft plan: (1) update docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md with a Web Console Zone Map covering every top-level api directory and first-level internal/handler domain, including whether each is transport edge, domain core, persistence adapter, integration adapter, substrate, composition root, or test/support; (2) add a Boundary Maturity section that cites existing enforcement tests in api/greenfield_assertions_test.go and names the missing generic import-graph/zone-reconciliation guard as remaining drift; (3) rewrite stale audio ownership prose to the post-adoption shape: audio-tools owns reusable audio, web-console consumes it via api/internal/audioports Remote* adapters and UI embed surfaces; remove references to deleted web-console internal/voice, internal/tts, handlers/voice, handlers/tts as present-day locations; (4) trim docs/internal/SEAMS.md stale legacy audio entries into either a short historical note or current audioports seam entries; (5) move completed/dead audio extraction details out of docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md or mark them closed, leaving only current unresolved boundary problems such as the missing generalized zone reconciliation test; (6) run docs structure tests and the focused greenfield boundary tests.

Acceptance: ARCHITECTURE.md has a Zone Map whose rows reconcile with find api -maxdepth 2 directory inventory; Boundary Maturity names API/UI/CLI levels and remaining drift; SEAMS.md no longer contains current-looking seam entries for deleted voice/tts packages; PROBLEMS.md only lists live unresolved boundary drift, not completed migration dossiers; focused go tests for existing boundary assertions still pass. Suggested skills: boundary-of-responsibility-enforcement, seam-discovery-and-enforcement, code-cleanup.
name: web-console-boundary-zone-map-doc-sync
title: Sync Web Console boundary docs with current package zones
